bio: Dig into a delicious Afternoon Tea with this relaxing experience for two at Hillthwaite.  Just a 15-minute walk from the beach the picturesque Hillthwaite surrounded by stunning views of Lake Windermere is the ideal venue for enjoying a relaxing afternoon with a loved one.  You'll be served a selection of freshly prepared finger sandwiches stuffed with classic fillings such as egg mayonnaise and coronation chicken, as well as fruit scones topped with jam and clotted cream and a moreish collection of handcrafted miniature cakes and pastries. A cold and crisp glass of fizz will finish off your decadent afternoon.
